description: Write all three test suites and the README. Depends on FEAT-001 (Jest installed, babel.config.js exists, styleMock.js exists) and FEAT-002 (ConfirmationModal exists for frontend.test.jsx). Backend server files are already complete from the skeleton so workspace.test.js and conversion.test.js can be written. Tests mock db.js so no live database is needed.
steps: 1. Write tests/workspace.test.js. At the very top (before any require): process.env.JWT_SECRET = 'test-secret-xyz'; process.env.DB_HOST = 'localhost'; process.env.DB_NAME = 'test';. Then: jest.mock('../server/db'). Import request from supertest, app from '../server/server', jwt from 'jsonwebtoken', db from '../server/db'. Helper: function makeToken(workspaceId=1, userId=1) { return jwt.sign({userId, workspaceId}, 'test-secret-xyz', {expiresIn:'1h'}); }. In beforeEach: jest.clearAllMocks(); db.query = jest.fn(). Test suite 'Workspace isolation': (a) 'GET /api/requests returns only workspace records' — db.query resolves [[{id:1,workspace_id:1,customer_name:'Test',customer_email:'t@t.com',requested_service:'S',status:'NEW',created_by:1,created_by_name:'Alice',has_work_item:0}]]; make GET /api/requests with Authorization Bearer token; expect 200 and response body to be an array. (b) 'GET /api/requests/:id returns 404 when workspace does not match' — db.query resolves [[]] (empty); make GET /api/requests/99 with token for workspace 1; expect 404. (c) 'PATCH /api/requests/:id returns 404 when workspace does not match' — db.query resolves [[]] first call (ownership check); make PATCH /api/requests/99 with token, body {status:'QUALIFIED'}; expect 404. (d) 'GET /api/requests with invalid status returns 400' — make GET /api/requests?status=INVALID with token; expect 400.

2. Write tests/conversion.test.js. At very top: process.env.JWT_SECRET = 'test-secret-xyz'; process.env.DB_HOST = 'localhost'; process.env.DB_NAME = 'test';. Then: jest.mock('../server/db'). Import request from supertest, app from '../server/server', jwt from 'jsonwebtoken', db from '../server/db'. Create a mockConnection factory: function makeMockConn() { return { beginTransaction: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(), query: jest.fn(), commit: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(), rollback: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(), release: jest.fn() }; }. Helper makeToken same as workspace test. beforeEach: jest.clearAllMocks(); db.query = jest.fn(). Test suite 'Request conversion': (a) 'converts QUALIFIED request successfully' — set up mockConn: conn.query: first call returns [[{id:5,status:'QUALIFIED',customer_name:'Jane',customer_email:'j@j.com',requested_service:'Dev',description:'x',scheduled_date:'2026-01-01',workspace_id:1,created_by:1}]], second call returns [[]] (no existing work item), third call returns [{insertId:10}], fourth call returns [[{id:1,name:'Alice'}]]; db.getConnection = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(mockConn); db.query = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue([[{id:10,request_id:5,title:'Dev — Jane',customer_name:'Jane',requested_service:'Dev',scheduled_date:'2026-01-01',workspace_id:1,created_by:1,created_by_name:'Alice'}]]); POST /api/requests/5/convert with token; expect 201. (b) 'returns 409 when request is not QUALIFIED' — conn.query first call returns request with status='NEW'; POST /api/requests/5/convert; expect 409 with message containing 'QUALIFIED'. (c) 'returns 409 when work item already exists' — conn.query: first returns QUALIFIED request, second returns [[{id:99}]] (existing work item); expect 409 with message containing 'already'. (d) 'returns 404 when request not in user workspace' — conn.query first returns [[]]; expect 404. (e) 'returns 409 on ER_DUP_ENTRY database error' — conn.query: first returns QUALIFIED request, second returns [[]], third throws error with code ER_DUP_ENTRY; expect 409.

3. Write tests/frontend.test.jsx. First line must be: /* @jest-environment jsdom */. Imports: import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react'; import ConfirmationModal from '../client/src/components/ConfirmationModal.jsx';. Define sampleRequest = { customer_name: 'Jane Doe', requested_service: 'Website Dev', scheduled_date: '2026-10-15' }. Test suite 'ConfirmationModal': (a) 'does not render when show is false' — render with show=false; expect(screen.queryByText('Convert to Work Item')).not.toBeInTheDocument(). (b) 'renders request details when show is true' — render with show=true and sampleRequest; expect(screen.getByText(/Jane Doe/i)).toBeInTheDocument(); expect(screen.getByText(/Website Dev/i)).toBeInTheDocument(). (c) 'onConfirm is not called on initial render' — const onConfirm=jest.fn(); render show=true; expect(onConfirm).not.toHaveBeenCalled(). (d) 'calls onCancel when Cancel button clicked' — const onCancel=jest.fn(); render show=true; fireEvent.click(screen.getByText(/Cancel/i)); expect(onCancel).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1). (e) 'calls onConfirm when Create Work Item button clicked' — const onConfirm=jest.fn(); render show=true; fireEvent.click(screen.getByText(/Create Work Item/i)); expect(onConfirm).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1). (f) 'Create Work Item button is disabled when loading is true' — render show=true loading=true; expect(screen.getByText(/Create Work Item/i)).toBeDisabled().

4. Run the full test suite: npx jest --testPathPattern=tests/ --forceExit from repo root. Fix any failures: common issues are (i) db mock not matching the pool API (ensure db.query and db.getConnection are set as jest.fn on the imported mock object), (ii) JWT_SECRET env var not set before server is loaded (must be at top of file before require), (iii) ConfirmationModal returning null when show=false means queryByText must be used not getByText, (iv) babel not handling JSX (ensure babel.config.js has @babel/preset-react).

5. Write README.md at the repo root. Content sections: ## Overview, ## Features, ## Tech Stack (table), ## Project Structure (directory tree), ## Architecture, ## Authentication, ## Workspace Isolation (explain the critical security rule and how WHERE id=? AND workspace_id=? enforces it), ## Duplicate Conversion Prevention (explain UNIQUE constraint + MySQL transaction + ER_DUP_ENTRY fallback), ## Database Setup (3 numbered steps: create database, execute schema.sql, run seed), ## Installation (copy .env.example, fill in values, run npm run install:all), ## Running in Development (npm run dev — explain it starts server on :5000 and client on :5173), ## Testing (npm test — explain tests mock the DB and run without a live database), ## Production Build (npm run build), ## Demo Credentials (table with workspace/email/password), ## Assumptions and Trade-offs (MySQL chosen per assignment instructions; explain trade-off vs PostgreSQL: MySQL is production-grade and widely deployed but PostgreSQL has richer JSON support and stricter standards compliance; bcryptjs is pure-JS for easier cross-platform installation; no ORM keeps SQL visible and easy to explain), ## Future Improvements, ## AI Usage (briefly disclose AI assistance was used in generating this project).
acceptance_criteria: workspace.test.js covers: isolation 404, workspace filter, invalid status 400
conversion.test.js covers: successful convert (201), non-QUALIFIED (409), duplicate (409), wrong workspace (404), ER_DUP_ENTRY (409)

frontend.test.jsx covers: modal hidden when show=false, modal shows data when show=true, API not called on open, onCancel fires on Cancel, onConfirm fires on Create Work Item, button disabled when loading=true
README.md exists and includes Database Setup, Installation, and Workspace Isolation sections

findings: Two bugs fixed: (1) server.js unconditionally called app.listen() causing EADDRINUSE when multiple test files required it in parallel — fixed with require.main === module guard. (2) Multiple React instances (client/node_modules/react vs root node_modules/react) caused 'ReactCurrentDispatcher' crash in frontend tests — fixed by adding moduleNameMapper entries in jest config to redirect react, react/jsx-runtime, react/jsx-dev-runtime, react-dom, and react-dom/client to root node_modules copies. All 17 tests pass (3 suites: workspace isolation, request conversion, ConfirmationModal component). README.md written with all required sections.
